segments.moves: //gs//Gs//g s//Gs//gqs//Ggs//gjs

comment: '/' then '/' calls a non-forced getpos(); Return dismisses the --More-- after its prompt. After the 'g' or 'G' prefix, getpos() reads the next key without the Escape test that precedes the prefix, so Escape, space and Return reach the quitchars test and print only 'Done.'; 'q' and a second 'g' are not quitchars and print the '(aborted)' diagnostic first; 'j' after the prefix fast-moves the cursor and a plain Escape then cancels.
